Nonparenchymal Hemangiosarcoma
記住 Intense Focal Enhancement

Fukuda et al.：多數 CT features 與其他 soft tissue sarcoma 重疊，但 13/17 腫瘤具有 highly attenuating intense focal enhancement，可能代表 vascular channels。

13/17intense focal enhancement
13/17subjectively invasive
12/17precontrast heterogeneous

Take-home判讀流程DataPatternsFiguresClinical use

Take-home Message

Most common baseline

Precontrast heterogeneous、invasive、heterogeneous enhancement。

Key clue

13/17 有 intense focal postcontrast enhancement。

Interpretation

可能代表 tumor vascular channels，但尚未 histologically validated。

Biopsy

避開最 intensely enhancing foci，選相對安全的 viable solid tissue。

快速 CT 判讀流程

  1. Precontrast：heterogeneous？hypoattenuating regions？calcification？
  2. Postcontrast：invasive margin？heterogeneous / ring enhancement？
  3. 主動尋找 intensely enhancing intratumoral foci。
  4. 必要時調整 high-contrast window settings。
  5. 比較 foci 與 nearby vessels 的 attenuation appearance。
  6. 做 regional node、cavitary fluid、major vessel relation 與 distant staging。
  7. 若 biopsy，避開最 vascular-appearing foci。

研究資料互動摘要

  • Mean maximal transverse diameter：6.2 cm。
  • 15/17 solitary；2/17 multiple。
  • 10/17 round；5/17 lobular；2/17 bone-contained。
  • 13/17 invasive；4/17 well-defined。
  • 12/17 precontrast heterogeneous。
  • Dystrophic calcification：1/17，而且 minimal/faint。

合計 13/17（76%）具有 intense focal enhancement。

  • Trunk：8/17。
  • Mesentery：3/17。
  • Retroperitoneum：2/17。
  • Nasal cavity、neck、limb、mandible：各 1/17。
  • Regional lymphomegaly：8/17（47%）。
  • Abdominal tumors with peritoneal fluid：1/6；confirmed hemoabdomen。
  • Thorax / liver / spleen coverage 並非全部病例完整，因此不能估算 metastatic prevalence。

Pattern Interpretation

Heterogeneous + invasive

Malignant soft tissue tumor pattern，但 nonspecific。

Ring enhancement

可見於 necrosis / hemorrhage；不要當成 HSA-specific。

Intense focal enhancement

Raises suspicion for vascular channels / vascular-origin tumor。

No calcification

Calcification uncommon，但 absence 不具診斷性。

最重要的限制

Intense focal enhancement 不是 pathognomonic。沒有 control group，也沒有 sensitivity/specificity。它是一個值得提高懷疑與影響 sampling strategy 的 CT clue。

影像圖例｜Figures

Fig. 1 — Noninvasive and invasive hemangiosarcoma

中文：非侵襲性（A）與侵襲性（B）hemangiosarcoma 的 CT 範例。兩個腫瘤都可見 intense focal contrast enhancement pattern。

English: Example of noninvasive (A) and invasive (B) hemangiosarcomas. Both tumors had an intense focal pattern of contrast enhancement.

Fig. 2 — Ring enhancement in paralumbar hemangiosarcoma

中文：Paralumbar hemangiosarcoma 的造影前（A）與造影後（B）CT 影像。造影前影像因周邊輕度低衰減區而呈 heterogeneous appearance；造影劑給予後，腫瘤顯影主要呈 ring pattern。

English: Precontrast (A) and postcontrast (B) CT images of a paralumbar hemangiosarcoma. In the precontrast image, there is a heterogeneous appearance due to a peripheral region of mild hypoattenuation. Following contrast-medium administration, the enhancement primarily exhibits a ring pattern.

Fig. 3 — Heterogeneous enhancement in perineal hemangiosarcoma

中文：Perineal hemangiosarcoma 的造影前（A）與造影後（B）CT 影像。造影前腫瘤呈 heterogeneous appearance；造影劑給予後呈 heterogeneous contrast enhancement。

English: Precontrast (A) and postcontrast (B) images of a perineal hemangiosarcoma. In the precontrast image, the tumor has a heterogeneous appearance and there is heterogeneous contrast enhancement following contrast-medium administration.

Fig. 4 — Intense focal enhancement across different tumor locations

中文：皮下（A）、肌肉內（B）、腸繫膜（C）與後腹腔（D）hemangiosarcoma 的造影後 CT 影像；四者皆可見 intense focal contrast enhancement regions。這些高衰減區在造影前影像中並不存在。後腹腔 hemangiosarcoma（D）的 intense focal enhancement 最不明顯；其他腫瘤的 pattern 與 A–C 更相似。

English: Post contrast images of subcutaneous (A), intramuscular (B), mesenteric (C), and retroperitoneal (D) hemangiosarcomas, all with intense focal regions of contrast enhancement. These hyperattenuating regions were not present in the precontrast images. The retroperitoneal hemangiosarcoma (D) had the least conspicuous regions of intense focal enhancement and in all other tumors the pattern was more similar to that seen in A–C.

Clinical Application

Recommended impression

The presence of intensely enhancing intratumoral foci raises concern for prominent vascular channels and increases suspicion for a vascular-origin neoplasm such as hemangiosarcoma, although definitive diagnosis requires tissue sampling.

Sampling pitfall

Highly vascular tumors 有出血風險。規劃 image-guided biopsy 時，應避開最 intensely enhancing foci、明顯大型血管與中央壞死區，選擇相對安全且 viable 的 solid target。

Bottom line

看到一般 aggressive soft tissue mass pattern 加上「像血管一樣亮的 intratumoral foci」時，把 hemangiosarcoma 拉高，但不要跳過 pathology。
